verses.1: Of David. To you, LORD, I call; my Rock, do not be deaf to me. If you fail to answer me, I will join those who go down to the pit.
verses.2: Hear the sound of my pleading when I cry to you, lifting my hands toward your holy place.
verses.3: Do not drag me off with the wicked, with those who do wrong, Who speak peace to their neighbors though evil is in their hearts.
verses.4: Repay them for their deeds, for the evil that they do. For the work of their hands repay them; give them what they deserve.
verses.5: They pay no heed to the LORD'S works, to the deeds of God's hands. God will tear them down, never to be rebuilt.
verses.6: Blessed be the LORD, who has heard the sound of my pleading.
verses.7: The LORD is my strength and my shield, in whom my heart trusted and found help. So my heart rejoices; with my song I praise my God.
verses.8: LORD, you are the strength of your people, the saving refuge of your anointed king.
verses.9: Save your people, bless your inheritance; feed and sustain them forever!

notes.text: Your holy place: the innermost part of the temple, the holy of holies, containing the ark. Cf 1 Kings 6:16, 19-23; 8:6-8.
The psalmist shifts to fervent thanksgiving, probably responding to a priestly or prophetic oracle in Psalm 28:5cd (not usually transmitted) assuring the worshiper that the prayer has been heard.
Your people... your anointed king: salvation is more than individual, affecting all the people and their God-given leader.
